'''2019 MPC Keith Brown LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Keith Brown]] at [[2019 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Keith Brown]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
